children: Prime Minister Carney's inaugural Canada Investment Summit this week drew some of the world's biggest capital managers, where they were pitched investment opportunities in shovel-ready developments. Any push to boost an underwhelming record on foreign direct investment is welcome, though National Bank's economists note the summit wasn't needed to spur foreign portfolio investment. Non-resident investors remain enthusiastic buyers of Canadian securities this year, confirmed by recent international securities transactions data, they note. Non-residents through July picked up a record year-to-date C$179 billion in Canadian portfolio securities, spurring a big swing in capital flows as Canadians have been net buyers of foreign securities but at a slower pace.
